verses.sloka: ततो रामः सुवेलाग्रं योजनद्वयमण्डलम् ।उपारोहत्ससुग्रीवो हरियूथैः समन्वितः ।। ६-४०-१।।
verses.transliteration: tato rāmaḥ suvelāgraṁ yojanadvayamaṇḍalam ।upārohatsasugrīvo hariyūthaiḥ samanvitaḥ ।। 6-40-1।।

translations.english: Rama accompanied by Vanara troop and Sugriva, ascended the peak of Suvela mountain spread over yojanas.
translations.hindi: OD १ रत्नानि- श्रैष्ठवस्तूति | (गो०) २ संविधानं--रक्षुणं । (गो०) As € दो योजन के घेरे में व्याप्त उस सुवेलपर्वत के शिखर पर सुग्रीब तथा वानरयूथपतियों को साथ लिए हुए श्रीरामचन्द्र जी चढ़ गए

verses.sloka: स्थित्वा मुहूर्तं तत्रैव दिशो दश विलोकयन् ।त्रिख़ूटशिखरे रम्ये निर्मितां विश्वकर्मणा ।। ६-४०-२।।
verses.transliteration: sthitvā muhūrtaṁ tatraiva diśo daśa vilokayan ।trikha़ūṭaśikhare ramye nirmitāṁ viśvakarmaṇā ।। 6-40-2।।

translations.english: Remaining there for a short while, Rama observed the view of Lanka in all directions. He saw Lanka built on the charming peak of Trikuta strongly by Vishwakarma, endowed with delightful groves.
translations.hindi: वहाँ एक घडी ठहर, चारों ओर दृष्टि डाल उन्होंने देखा । रमणीय त्रिकूटाचल के ख्ूड़ पर विश्वकमा की बनाई हुई

verses.sloka: ददर्श लङ्कां सुन्यस्तां रम्यकाननशोभिताम् ।तस्यां गोपुरशृङ्गस्थं राक्षसेन्द्रं दुरासदम् ।। ६-४०-३।।
verses.transliteration: dadarśa laṅkāṁ sunyastāṁ ramyakānanaśobhitām ।tasyāṁ gopuraśṛṅgasthaṁ rākṣasendraṁ durāsadam ।। 6-40-3।।

translations.english: From there Rama saw on the peak of the tower the Rakshasa king, who is difficult to approach. He was fanned by white whisks on both sides, graced with triumphal parasol, decorated his body with red sandal paste, adorned in redcoloured ornaments, resembling dark clouds, attired in red like the hare's blood, embroidered with golden thread, with scars on his chest caused by indentations made by the tusks of Airavata the elephant of Indra, looked like a mass of cloud covered by sunshine at dusk.
translations.hindi: लङ्का को श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने देखा । लङ्कापुरी बड़ी सुन्दर रीति से बसाई गई थी और बड़े रमणीक काननों से सुशोभित थी । उसके फाटक के शिखर पर दुधेष रावण बैठा हुआ था

verses.sloka: श्वेतचामरपर्यन्तं विजयच्चत्रशोभितम् ।रक्तचन्दनसंलिप्तं रक्ताभरणभूषितम् ।। ६-४०-४।।
verses.transliteration: śvetacāmaraparyantaṁ vijayaccatraśobhitam ।raktacandanasaṁliptaṁ raktābharaṇabhūṣitam ।। 6-40-4।।

translations.english: From there Rama saw on the peak of the tower the Rakshasa king, who is difficult to approach. He was fanned by white whisks on both sides, graced with triumphal parasol, decorated his body with red sandal paste, adorned in redcoloured ornaments, resembling dark clouds, attired in red like the hare's blood, embroidered with golden thread, with scars on his chest caused by indentations made by the tusks of Airavata the elephant of Indra, looked like a mass of cloud covered by sunshine at dusk.
translations.hindi: उसके माथे पर विजयसूचक छत्र तना हुआ था, उसके अगल बगल दो सफेद चँवर डुलाए जा रहे थे । उसके शरीर में लाल चन्दन लगा हुआ था और वह रत्नजटित आभूषण पहिने हुए था

verses.sloka: वीलजीमूतसंकाशं हेमसंचादिताम्बरम् ।ऐरावतविषाणाग्रैरुत्कृष्टकिणवक्षसम् ।। ६-४०-५।।
verses.transliteration: vīlajīmūtasaṁkāśaṁ hemasaṁcāditāmbaram ।airāvataviṣāṇāgrairutkṛṣṭakiṇavakṣasam ।। 6-40-5।।

translations.english: From there Rama saw on the peak of the tower the Rakshasa king, who is difficult to approach. He was fanned by white whisks on both sides, graced with triumphal parasol, decorated his body with red sandal paste, adorned in redcoloured ornaments, resembling dark clouds, attired in red like the hare's blood, embroidered with golden thread, with scars on his chest caused by indentations made by the tusks of Airavata the elephant of Indra, looked like a mass of cloud covered by sunshine at dusk.
translations.hindi: £ नील मेघ की तरह उसके शरीर की कान्ति थी और वह जुर« दोजी ( कलाबत्त ) के काम के कपड़े पहिने हुए था । उसकी छाती में ऐरावत हाथी के दाँत लगने का चिह्न था

verses.sloka: शशलोहितरागेण सम्वीतं रक्तवाससा ।संध्यातपेन संचन्नं मेघराशिमिवाम्बरे ।। ६-४०-६।।
verses.transliteration: śaśalohitarāgeṇa samvītaṁ raktavāsasā ।saṁdhyātapena saṁcannaṁ megharāśimivāmbare ।। 6-40-6।।

translations.english: From there Rama saw on the peak of the tower the Rakshasa king, who is difficult to approach. He was fanned by white whisks on both sides, graced with triumphal parasol, decorated his body with red sandal paste, adorned in redcoloured ornaments, resembling dark clouds, attired in red like the hare's blood, embroidered with golden thread, with scars on his chest caused by indentations made by the tusks of Airavata the elephant of Indra, looked like a mass of cloud covered by sunshine at dusk.
translations.hindi: उसकी पोशाक खरगोश के रक्त की तरह लाल रंग की थी । इस सजावट से वह ऐता जान पड़ता था, माना सन्ध्या कालीन घूप से ढकी हुई मेघघटाए

verses.sloka: पश्यतां वानरेन्द्राणाम् राघवस्यापि पश्यतः ।दर्शनाद्राक्षसेन्द्रस्य सुग्रीवः सहसोत्थितः ।। ६-४०-७।।
verses.transliteration: paśyatāṁ vānarendrāṇām rāghavasyāpi paśyataḥ ।darśanādrākṣasendrasya sugrīvaḥ sahasotthitaḥ ।। 6-40-7।।

translations.english: Looking at the sight of Raghava seeing Rakshasa king, Sugriva the king of Vanaras got up instantly rashly.
translations.hindi: इस प्रकार के रात्तसराज रावण को संग्रीब न तथा श्रीराम चन्द्र जी ने भी देखा। क्रिन्तु रावण को देख सुग्रीव से न रहा गया आर वे सहसा उठ खड़े हुए

verses.sloka: क्रोधवेगेन सं युक्तः सत्त्वेन च बलेन च ।अचलाग्रादथोत्थाय पुप्लुवे गोपुरस्थले ।। ६-४०-८।।
verses.transliteration: krodhavegena saṁ yuktaḥ sattvena ca balena ca ।acalāgrādathotthāya pupluve gopurasthale ।। 6-40-8।।

translations.english: Provoked by anger, courageous and strong Sugriva rose up impelled by impetuosity and flew to the peak of the tower.

verses.sloka: स्थित्वा मुहूर्तं सम्प्रेक्ष्य निर्भयेनान्तरात्मना ।तृणीकृत्य च तद्रक्षः सोऽब्रवीत्परुषं वचः ।। ६-४०-९।।
verses.transliteration: sthitvā muhūrtaṁ samprekṣya nirbhayenāntarātmanā ।tṛṇīkṛtya ca tadrakṣaḥ so'bravītparuṣaṁ vacaḥ ।। 6-40-9।।

translations.english: For a moment he stood looking at the ogre fearlessly in his mind and treating him like straw spoke harsh words.

verses.sloka: लोकनाथस्य रामस्य सखा दासोऽस्मि राक्षस ।न मया मोक्यसे.द्य त्वं पार्थिवेन्द्रस्य तेजसा ।। ६-४०-१०।।
verses.transliteration: lokanāthasya rāmasya sakhā dāso'smi rākṣasa ।na mayā mokyase.dya tvaṁ pārthivendrasya tejasā ।। 6-40-10।।

translations.english: "O Rakshasa! I am a friend and servant of the king of kings, ruler of the world. By his power I will not leave you!", Sugriva said.

verses.sloka: इत्युक्त्वा सहसोत्पत्य प्लुप्लुवे तस्य चोपरि ।आकृष्य मुकुटं चित्रं पातयामास तद्भुवि ।। ६-४०-११।।
verses.transliteration: ityuktvā sahasotpatya plupluve tasya copari ।ākṛṣya mukuṭaṁ citraṁ pātayāmāsa tadbhuvi ।। 6-40-11।।

translations.english: Having spoken thus, Sugriva got up speedily and flew to the top of the tower (here Ravana was located) held the diadem and pushed it on the ground.

verses.sloka: समीक्स्य तूर्णमायान्तं बभाषे तं निशाचरः ।सुग्रीवस्त्वं परोक्षे मे हीनग्रीवो भविष्यसि ।। ६-४०-१२।।
verses.transliteration: samīksya tūrṇamāyāntaṁ babhāṣe taṁ niśācaraḥ ।sugrīvastvaṁ parokṣe me hīnagrīvo bhaviṣyasi ।। 6-40-12।।

translations.english: Observing Sugriva coming towards him, Ravana said, "When you were not seen by me you had a neck. I will make you neckless."
translations.hindi: मुकुट गिरा कर उनको फिर भी फुर्तो के साथ -अपने ऊपर झपटते देख, रावण ने कहा-सुग्रीन जब तक तू मेरे नेत्रों की आड़ में था तभी तक तू सुग्रीव था, पर अब्र तू हीनग्रीब हो जायगा

verses.sloka: इत्युक्त्वोत्थाय तं क्षिप्रं बाहुभ्यामाक्षिपत्तले ।कन्दुवत्स समुत्थाय बाहुभ्यामाक्षिपद्धरिः ।। ६-४०-१३।।
verses.transliteration: ityuktvotthāya taṁ kṣipraṁ bāhubhyāmākṣipattale ।kanduvatsa samutthāya bāhubhyāmākṣipaddhariḥ ।। 6-40-13।।

translations.english: Telling like that that Ravana got up and threw Sugriva by his hand s to the ground. Then Sugriva getting up like a ball fallen pushed Ravana down.

verses.sloka: परस्परं स्वेदविदिग्धगात्रौ ।परस्परम् शोणितरक्तदेहौ ।परस्परं श्लिष्टनिरुद्धचेष्टौ ।परस्परं शाल्मलिकिंशुकाविव ।। ६-४०-१४।।
verses.transliteration: parasparaṁ svedavidigdhagātrau ।parasparam śoṇitaraktadehau ।parasparaṁ śliṣṭaniruddhaceṣṭau ।parasparaṁ śālmalikiṁśukāviva ।। 6-40-14।।

translations.english: Sugriva and Ravana, their bodies sweating all over, bodies coloured red with blood looking like red silk cotton trees, their bodies clinging together interlocked with each other stood motionless. They were fighting with their fists, palms and blows of forearms, hurting each other with nails and carrying out unbearable forms of war.
translations.hindi: वा० रा० यु०--२४ ३४० युद्धकाण्डे बहे Ayasthi Sahib Bhuvan दसर st Do प जब चे दोनों इसे प्रकार एके दूसरे से लड़ने लगे तब्र दोन के शरीर पसीना व रुधिर से तर बतर हो गए । वे एक दूसरे से लिपट जाते थे ओर कुछ काल के लिए दोनों चेष्टार हित (भी) हो जाते थे । खून से लथपथ वे सेमर और ढाक के पेड़ की तरह देख पड़ते थे

verses.sloka: मुष्टिप्रहारैश्च तलप्रहारै ।ररत्निघातैश्च कराग्रघातैः ।तौ चक्रतुर्युद्धमसह्यरूपं ।महाबलौ राक्षसवानरेन्द्रौ ।। ६-४०-१५।।
verses.transliteration: muṣṭiprahāraiśca talaprahārai ।raratnighātaiśca karāgraghātaiḥ ।tau cakraturyuddhamasahyarūpaṁ ।mahābalau rākṣasavānarendrau ।। 6-40-15।।

translations.english: Sugriva and Ravana, their bodies sweating all over, bodies coloured red with blood looking like red silk cotton trees, their bodies clinging together interlocked with each other stood motionless. They were fighting with their fists, palms and blows of forearms, hurting each other with nails and carrying out unbearable forms of war.

verses.sloka: कृत्वा नियुद्धं भृशमुग्रवेगौ ।कालं चिरं गोपुरवेदिमध्ये ।उत्क्षिप्य चोत्क्षिप्य विनम्य देहौ ।पादक्रमाद्गोपुरवेदिलग्नौ ।। ६-४०-१६।।
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā niyuddhaṁ bhṛśamugravegau ।kālaṁ ciraṁ gopuravedimadhye ।utkṣipya cotkṣipya vinamya dehau ।pādakramādgopuravedilagnau ।। 6-40-16।।

translations.english: Violently fighting like that aggressively for long, throwing each other down repeatedly, bending and moving their feet in a direction, stood on the fl at area of the peak in the middle portion.
translations.hindi: फाटक को छत पर इस तरह वे दोनों उम्र पराक्रमी बहुत देर तक युद्ध करते रहे | हाथापाई करते करते यहाँ तक नौबत पहुँची कि, कभी रावण सुग्रीव को और कभी सुग्रीव रावण को पकड़ कर, ऊपर उछाल देता था। कभी कभी पैतरे बदलते हुए दोनों, कुछ देर के लिए, एक दूसरे की घात में खड़े हो जाते थे

verses.sloka: अन्योन्यमापीड्य विलग्नदेहौ ।तौ पेतुतुः पालनिखातमध्ये ।उत्पेततुर्भूमितलम् स्पृशन्तौ ।स्थित्वा मुहूर्तं त्वभिनिःश्वसन्तौ ।। ६-४०-१७।।
verses.transliteration: anyonyamāpīḍya vilagnadehau ।tau petutuḥ pālanikhātamadhye ।utpetaturbhūmitalam spṛśantau ।sthitvā muhūrtaṁ tvabhiniḥśvasantau ।। 6-40-17।।

translations.english: Squeezing their bodies of each other they dropped down between the boundary of the peak and the moat. They were gasping heavily for a moment and clung their body to each other jumping.
translations.hindi: दोनों लड़ते लड़ते एक दूसरे से' लिपटे हुए परकोटे की खाँई में गिर पड़े । किन्तु खाँई की तली में पहुँचने के पूर्व वे दोनों उछल कर, पुनः ऊपर आए ओर ऊपर आ कर कुछ देर तक दम लेते हुए खड़े रहे

verses.sloka: आलिङ्ग्य चालिङ्ग़्य च बाहुयोक्त्रैः ।संयोजयामासतुराहवे तौ ।सम्रम्भशिक्षाबलसम्प्रयुक्तौ ।सुचेरतुः सम्प्रति युद्धमार्गे ।। ६-४०-१८।।
verses.transliteration: āliṅgya cāliṅga़्ya ca bāhuyoktraiḥ ।saṁyojayāmāsaturāhave tau ।samrambhaśikṣābalasamprayuktau ।suceratuḥ samprati yuddhamārge ।। 6-40-18।।

translations.english: Both pressing their bosom to each other, clung to each other, and fastened themselves in embrace in the comb at having received similar training in war and both endowed with might. At this time, they went on in comb at using several war methods.
translations.hindi: तदनन्तर फिर उन दोनों की भिड्न्त हुई और दोनों में हाथापाई होने लगी.। आवेश में भर वे अपने अपने ( मल्लयुद्ध के ) अभ्यास और ( शारीरिक ) शक्ति को दिखाते हुए एक दूसरे. को पकड़ने दी घात में लगे हुए घूम रहे थे

verses.sloka: शार्दूलसिंहविव जातदंष्ट्रौ ।गजेन्द्रपोताविव संप्रयुक्तौ ।संहत्य संवेद्य च तौ कराभ्यां ।तऊ पेतुतुर्वै युगपद्धरायाम् ।। ६-४०-१९।।
verses.transliteration: śārdūlasiṁhaviva jātadaṁṣṭrau ।gajendrapotāviva saṁprayuktau ।saṁhatya saṁvedya ca tau karābhyāṁ ।taū petuturvai yugapaddharāyām ।। 6-40-19।।

translations.english: Both of them resembled a tiger and lion affected by pride, connecting to each other through their shoulders like Lordly elephants, hitting and hurting one another holding one another fell down at once simultaneously.

verses.sloka: उद्यम्य चान्योन्यमधिक्षिपन्तौ ।संचक्रमाते बहु युद्धमार्गे ।व्यायामशिक्षाबलसंप्रयुक्तौ ।क्लमं न तौ जग्मतुराशु वीरौ ।। ६-४०-२०।।
verses.transliteration: udyamya cānyonyamadhikṣipantau ।saṁcakramāte bahu yuddhamārge ।vyāyāmaśikṣābalasaṁprayuktau ।klamaṁ na tau jagmaturāśu vīrau ।। 6-40-20।।

translations.english: Both of them were holding one another, snubbing each other gradually following many kinds of combat. As both the heroes were well trained in wrestling and fighting, they did not feel tiresome.
translations.hindi: एक दूसरे को उठा उठा कर पटक देते थे और दोनों ही उठ उठ कर वहाँ चक्कर लगाने लगते थे । क्योंकि दोनों ही मल्लयुद्ध- बिद्या में अभ्यस्त होने के कारण पर्याप्त बलसम्पन्न थे । इसीसे वे दोनों वीर शीघ्र थके भी नहीं थे

verses.sloka: बाहुत्तमैर्वारणवारणाभै ।र्निवारयन्तौ परवारणाभौ।चिरेण कालेन भृशं प्रयुद्धौ ।संचेरतुर्मण्डलमार्गमाशु ।। ६-४०-२१।।
verses.transliteration: bāhuttamairvāraṇavāraṇābhai ।rnivārayantau paravāraṇābhau।cireṇa kālena bhṛśaṁ prayuddhau ।saṁceraturmaṇḍalamārgamāśu ।। 6-40-21।।

translations.english: Both Ravana and Sugriva endowed with mighty arms, were resisting each other, and keeping away one another engaging in comb at for a long time. They kept on moving, going around each other swiftly.
translations.hindi: मतवाले हाथियों की सू डों की तरह अपने हाथों से एक दूसरे को रोकते हुए, वे वईत देर तक कुश्ती लड़ कर, मण्डलाकार हो, लड़ने लगे

verses.sloka: तौ परस्पर मासाद्य यत्तावन्योन्यसूदने ।मार्जाराविव भक्षार्थेऽवतस्थाते मुहुर्मुहुः ।। ६-४०-२२।।
verses.transliteration: tau paraspara māsādya yattāvanyonyasūdane ।mārjārāviva bhakṣārthe'vatasthāte muhurmuhuḥ ।। 6-40-22।।

translations.english: Both of them intent on destroying each other were approaching one another and now and then growling like cats for the sake of food.
translations.hindi: किसी खाद्य पदाथ के लिए लड़ने वाले दो बिलारों की तरह; वे दोनों आपस में एक दूसरे को ओर निश्चल भाव से खड़े हुए चक्कर लगाते थे

verses.sloka: मण्डलानि विचित्राणि स्थानानि विविधानि च ।गोमूत्रकाणि चित्राणि गतप्रत्यागतानि च ।। ६-४०-२३।।
verses.transliteration: maṇḍalāni vicitrāṇi sthānāni vividhāni ca ।gomūtrakāṇi citrāṇi gatapratyāgatāni ca ।। 6-40-23।।

translations.english: Both Vanara king and Ravana being learned in war craft, went around in circles like ox's urine, stood in different wonderful postures, moved forward and backward horizontally and obliquely to evade movements, hitting, and delivering each other, standing steadily motionless, striking, jumping, assaulting each other coming forward and going away, going backwards jumping from behind, holding hands and folding to resist exhibiting their skill in combat.
translations.hindi: वे कभी विचित्र रीति से चक्कर काट, कभी पैरों को तिरके रख, कभी टेढी मेढी चाल से, कभी बेंड्रे हो कर, कभी चक्कर काट कर, कभी वार बचा कर, कभी दौड़ कर, कभो उछल कर, कभी घात लगा कर खड़े रह कर, कभो पीछे देखते हुए चल कर, कभी घुटनों के बल्न परस्पर समीप खड़े रह कर, कभी लात मारने के लिए उछल कर, कभी बाहों की पकड़ बचाने को छाती फुज्ञा ओर आगे कर के, कभी शत्रु की भुजाओं को पक्रड़ने के लिए हाथों को फैचा कर, वे दोनों मल्लयुद्ध विशारद वानरराज ओर राक्षसराज, घूम घूम कर लड़ रहे थे

verses.sloka: तीर्शीनगतान्येव तथा वक्रगतानि च ।परिमोक्षं प्रहाराणां वर्जनं परिधावनम् ।। ६-४०-२४।।
verses.transliteration: tīrśīnagatānyeva tathā vakragatāni ca ।parimokṣaṁ prahārāṇāṁ varjanaṁ paridhāvanam ।। 6-40-24।।

translations.english: Both Vanara king and Ravana being learned in war craft, went around in circles like ox's urine, stood in different wonderful postures, moved forward and backward horizontally and obliquely to evade movements, hitting, and delivering each other, standing steadily motionless, striking, jumping, assaulting each other coming forward and going away, going backwards jumping from behind, holding hands and folding to resist exhibiting their skill in combat.

verses.sloka: अभिद्रवणमाप्लावमवस्थानं सविग्रहम् ।परावृत्तमपावृत्तमपद्रुतमवप्लुतम् ।। ६-४०-२५।।
verses.transliteration: abhidravaṇamāplāvamavasthānaṁ savigraham ।parāvṛttamapāvṛttamapadrutamavaplutam ।। 6-40-25।।

translations.english: Both Vanara king and Ravana being learned in war craft, went around in circles like ox's urine, stood in different wonderful postures, moved forward and backward horizontally and obliquely to evade movements, hitting, and delivering each other, standing steadily motionless, striking, jumping, assaulting each other coming forward and going away, going backwards jumping from behind, holding hands and folding to resist exhibiting their skill in combat.

verses.sloka: उपन्यस्तमपन्यस्तं युद्धमार्गविशारदौ ।तौ विचेरतुर्न्योन्यं वानरेन्द्रश्च रावणः ।। ६-४०-२६।।
verses.transliteration: upanyastamapanyastaṁ yuddhamārgaviśāradau ।tau viceraturnyonyaṁ vānarendraśca rāvaṇaḥ ।। 6-40-26।।

translations.english: Both Vanara king and Ravana being learned in war craft, went around in circles like ox's urine, stood in different wonderful postures, moved forward and backward horizontally and obliquely to evade movements, hitting, and delivering each other, standing steadily motionless, striking, jumping, assaulting each other coming forward and going away, going backwards jumping from behind, holding hands and folding to resist exhibiting their skill in combat.

verses.sloka: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे रक्षो मायाबलमथात्मनः ।आरब्दुमुपसम् पेदे ज्ञात्वा तम् वानराधिपः ।। ६-४०-२७।।
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare rakṣo māyābalamathātmanaḥ ।ārabdumupasam pede jñātvā tam vānarādhipaḥ ।। 6-40-27।।

translations.english: In the meantime, Ravana thought of exhibiting his superiority by jugglery and jumped to the sky. Knowing that Sugriva, the untiring Vanara king assumed the air of victor and rose up to the sky. Baffled Ravana stood thinking Sugriva would come there.

verses.sloka: उत्पपात तदाकाशं जितकाशी जितक्लमः ।रावणः स्थित एवात्र हरिराजेन वञ्चितः ।। ६-४०-२८।।
verses.transliteration: utpapāta tadākāśaṁ jitakāśī jitaklamaḥ ।rāvaṇaḥ sthita evātra harirājena vañcitaḥ ।। 6-40-28।।

translations.english: In the meantime, Ravana thought of exhibiting his superiority by jugglery and jumped to the sky. Knowing that Sugriva, the untiring Vanara king assumed the air of victor and rose up to the sky. Baffled Ravana stood thinking Sugriva would come there.
translations.hindi: तब तो पूरी दम रखने वाले एबं विजयी सुग्रीव ने बहाँ से ऊपर को छलाँग मारी । रावण भौंचक सा खड़ा देखता ही रह गया । कपिराज ने उसे खूब छकाया

verses.sloka: अथ हरिवरनाथः प्राप्तसंग्रामकीर्ति ।र्निशिचरपतिमाजौ योजयित्वा श्रमेण ।गगनमतिविशालं लङ्घयित्वार्कसूम ।र्हरिगणबलमध्ये रामपार्श्वं जगाम् ।। ६-४०-२९।।
verses.transliteration: atha harivaranāthaḥ prāptasaṁgrāmakīrti ।rniśicarapatimājau yojayitvā śrameṇa ।gaganamativiśālaṁ laṅghayitvārkasūma ।rharigaṇabalamadhye rāmapārśvaṁ jagām ।। 6-40-29।।

translations.english: Then Sugriva, the Sun god's son, the Lord of Vanara chiefs, who had won fame of winning in battles, victorious exhausting Ravana in comb at flying the extensive sky reached Rama who was amid Vanara army.

verses.sloka: स इति सवितृसूनुस्तत्र तत्कर्म कृत्वा ।पवनगतिरनीकं प्राविशत्संप्रहृष्टः ।रघुवरनृपसूनोद्वर्धयन् युद्धहर्षं ।तरुमृगगणमुख्यैः पूज्यमानो हरीन्द्रः ।। ६-४०-३०
verses.transliteration: sa iti savitṛsūnustatra tatkarma kṛtvā ।pavanagatiranīkaṁ prāviśatsaṁprahṛṣṭaḥ ।raghuvaranṛpasūnodvardhayan yuddhaharṣaṁ ।tarumṛgagaṇamukhyaiḥ pūjyamāno harīndraḥ ।। 6-40-30

translations.english: Sugriva the son of the Sun god, having completed the feat, rejoiced by increasing the joy of foremost of Raghus. Then he who is adored by the monkey chiefs entered the army of Vanaras. ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेचत्वारिंशस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the fortieth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
translations.hindi: इस प्रकार वानरराज सुग्रीव ने वल लगा कर, राक्षसराज रावण को थका डाला और इस प्रकार त्रिजय रूपी कीर्ति प्राप्त कर, फिर सूर्यपुत्र सुंव विशाल आकाश को लाघ कर, वानरो के बीच बैठे हुए श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के पाप आ पहुँचे २६ ॥ ~ 2 (0 है इति स सबितृस्रनुस्तत्र तत्कमे कृत्वा पवनगतिरनीक प्राविशस्सम्प्रहृष्ट; । रघुवरनपसनोवधपन्युद्हरष तरुमृगगण मुख्यै;पूज्यमानो हरीन्द्रः
